title: EnumBundle
description: Compact controlled-vocabulary bundle emitted by scripts/extract-enum-bundle.py for consumption by the LLM prompt builder (#188).

_meta.description: Provenance metadata. Informational; ignored by the prompt builder.

vessel_class_tree.description: Hierarchical projection of the platform registry's vessel-class tree. Platform-instance leaves are stripped.

nationalities.description: Sorted, deduplicated nationality codes from registry + catalog.

exercise_names.description: Sorted, deduplicated exercise names parsed from item titles (substring before first ': ').

tags.description: Sorted, deduplicated values from debrief:tags across all catalog items.

feature_tags.description: Sorted, deduplicated values from debrief:feature_tags across all catalog items.

ClassTreeNode.description: Recursive vessel-class node. May carry a _class block of display metadata; all other keys are interior child nodes (no platform leaves).

_class.description: Display metadata passed through from the registry.
